description_en: Replicates a parameter template to the current region or another region
description_zh: 该接口用于复制RDS参数模板到当前地域或其他地域内
kebab_example: aliyun rds clone-parameter-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --target-region-id cn-qingdao --parameter-group-id rpg-13ppdh0000 --parameter-group-name tartestgroup --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloneParameterGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source region to which the parameter template belongs. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 源参数模板地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination region. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 目标地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: target_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parameter template. You can call the DescribeParameterGroups operation to query the parameter template ID
parameters.help_zh: 源参数模板ID。可以通过DescribeParameterGroups查看参数模板ID
parameters.name: parameter_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the parameter template in the destination region
parameters.help_zh: 目标地域复制的参数模板名称
parameters.name: parameter_group_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the parameter template in the destination region
parameters.help_zh: 目标地域复制的参数模板描述
parameters.name: parameter_group_desc

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. You can leave this parameter empty
parameters.name: resource_group_id
